movie.title: A Child of My Own
movie.overview: Desperate for a baby and burdened by family and societal expectations, a woman fakes a pregnancy and gets tangled in a crime.

aiEnrichment.summary_one_sentence: Driven by intense social and familial pressure to have a baby, a desperate woman fakes a pregnancy and becomes entangled in a dangerous crime.
aiEnrichment.summary_short: A Child of My Own follows a woman struggling under the crushing weight of societal and family expectations to become a mother. Unable to conceive, she makes the radical choice to fake a pregnancy to maintain appearances. However, her desperate deception quickly spirals out of control, dragging her into a web of criminal activity. As the lies compound, she must navigate the dangerous consequences of her actions while keeping her secret buried.
aiEnrichment.summary_long: The narrative centers on a woman whose life is dominated by an overwhelming desire for motherhood, compounded by intense pressure from her family and society. Facing immense internal grief and external scrutiny, she reaches a breaking point and decides to fabricate a pregnancy. What starts as a desperate bid to buy time and save face rapidly transforms into a high-stakes deception. To sustain the lie, she goes to extreme lengths, creating a facade that grows increasingly fragile with each passing month. Her actions eventually cross legal boundaries, drawing her into a world of crime that she is wholly unprepared to navigate. As law enforcement and suspicious loved ones draw closer, the psychological toll of her dual life begins to unravel her sanity. Every attempt to cover her tracks only pulls her deeper into criminal complicity and moral jeopardy. Ultimately, her quest for a child forces her to confront the catastrophic consequences of her choices, testing the limits of how far one will go to fulfill a personal obsession.
aiEnrichment.synopsis: A Child of My Own is a gripping dramatic documentary that explores the intense, often taboo pressures surrounding motherhood and family expectations. The story follows a woman who, consumed by the desire to have a baby and unable to meet the overwhelming demands of her social circle, embarks on a dangerous path of deception by faking a pregnancy. As she tries to navigate the complex illusion she has created, the narrative delves into the psychological strain of her secret and the unforeseen criminal escalation that follows. Blending dramatic narrative elements with raw documentary-style realism, the film offers an intimate and haunting look at desperation, societal stigma, and the destructive lengths to which a person will go to claim a life they feel destined to have.

story_structure.climax: The criminal entanglement reaches a critical breaking point, exposing her deception and forcing a direct confrontation with the consequences of her choices.
story_structure.conflict: As her lie grows increasingly difficult to maintain, she becomes unintentionally entangled in a criminal scheme while trying to secure a child.
story_structure.resolution: The fallout of her actions is resolved, forcing her to face reality and bear the personal and legal aftermath of the life she attempted to fabricate.
story_structure.introduction: A woman facing immense family and social pressure to have a baby makes the desperate decision to fake a pregnancy to fulfill expectations.
story_structure.risingAction: She is forced to navigate a web of deception, escalating threats, and legal danger, forcing her to make riskier choices to cover her tracks.
